import Part, Sketcher
doc=FreeCAD.getDocument("hook_lesson3")
sh=doc.Spreadsheet; body=doc.Body
sh.set('A6','hole_d'); sh.set('B6','=4 mm'); sh.setAlias('B6','hole_d')
sh.set('A7','hole_spacing'); sh.set('B7','=30 mm'); sh.setAlias('B7','hole_spacing')
doc.recompute()
sk=body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject','HoleSketch')
sk.AttachmentSupport=(doc.YZ_Plane,[''])
sk.MapMode='FlatFace'
doc.recompute()
S='Spreadsheet.'
for i,sgn in enumerate((-1,1)):
    sk.addGeometry(Part.Circle(App.Vector(-10,30+sgn*15,0),App.Vector(0,0,1),2),False)
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Diameter',i,4))
    sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%(sk.ConstraintCount-1),S+'hole_d')
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX',-1,1,i,3,-10))
    sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%(sk.ConstraintCount-1),'-'+S+'width / 2')
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY',-1,1,i,3,30+sgn*15))
    sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%(sk.ConstraintCount-1),S+'plate_height / 2 %s %shole_spacing / 2'%('+' if sgn>0 else '-',S))
doc.recompute()
pk=body.newObject('PartDesign::Pocket','HolePocket')
pk.Profile=sk; pk.Type=1; pk.Midplane=True
doc.recompute()
print(sk.solve(),pk.Shape.isValid(),pk.Shape.Volume,pk.State)
for c in sk.Geometry: print(c.Center,c.Radius)
# find fillet edge
s=pk.Shape
for i,e in enumerate(s.Edges):
    bb=e.BoundBox
    if abs(bb.XMin-40)<1e-6 and abs(bb.ZMin-10)<1e-6 and abs(bb.ZMax-10)<1e-6: print('edge',i+1,bb)
